notes: All runs use archived base save, seven enabled mods, and CE1.28 reticle protection. Native arms retain audited original main-loop bytes.
52-second triple-item cases are not a matched-duration native comparison; the fresh native reference is 12 simulation seconds of firing.
R12 triple-item soak includes four seconds of PipeWire/JPEG capture and 15seconds of CPU/DRM observation. R11 corresponding soak has neither successful telemetry nor capture.
Successful SwapBuffers cadence does not by itself prove distinct images or physical scanout.
Budget-enabled runs deliberately change player split/laser/cosmetic output. No gameplay-damage equivalence is asserted.
First-shot intervals and whole-run hitches remain included in metrics, separately from sustained fire.
One R11 startup attempt timed out before fixture execution; retry completed. Startup failure is not counted as a performance pass.

Combat uses four seeded high-HP Gapers whose positions/velocities are restored each native world update in both arms. Original freeze-only fixture drifted and changed room; that incomplete attempt is excluded. Native damage callbacks and HP loss remain real, but this is synthetic stationary collision stress, not normal enemy AI.

R13 also had a pre-fixture startup timeout in the marked-target control case; startup reliability remains under investigation. An unrelated native light-profile run was interrupted by a runner scheduling mistake and explicitly invalidated; an exclusive prefix lease now rejects concurrent runners.
r12_load_scope: Isolated DRM client counters may be shared with another holder of the same client; systemwide sysfs also includes other programs. Main thread measured on one-core scale.

r12_capture.roi_selection_note: Explicit room interior ROI; caller must visually verify it excludes HUD for this scene.

algorithm.pair_rule: every consecutive index i->i+1, both timestamps retained; no index/FPS reconstruction
algorithm.threshold_purpose: reduces small intensity/few-pixel noise; does not establish optical flow or exclude all compression/lighting changes

limits: Offline source metadata matches the case launcher; this does not freshly authenticate an ended PipeWire source.
Capture clock is PipeWire/GStreamer buffer timestamps. Capture latency, dropped/unobserved game frames and physical scanout timing are unknown.
Distinct captured room images do not prove every native presentation was captured, interpolation correctness or a physical refresh rate.
No timestamp join with native QPC or fixture wall clock is attempted without a shared-clock proof.

normal_shutdown.scope: verified isolated keyboard; normal save/exit then WM_DELETE_WINDOW

r13_low_load_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic removes only three Twisted Pair copies; not original-combination performance baseline

events.scope: 698x3 removal only; native transformation/familiar lifecycle retained; not user-combo performance baseline
